symptom: `mxcli syntax database-connection` documented `DROP DATABASE CONNECTION Module.Name;`, which was a parse error; `SHOW REFERENCES OF` in docs-site was never valid (the grammar is `REFERENCES TO`).
cause: The syntax reference and docs-site are hand-written and nothing parses their statements against the grammar; the drop was documented ahead of an implementation that never came.
insight: Implemented `drop database connection [if exists]` (and `drop validation rule`, `drop external entity`) and corrected the docs. `make check-skill-mdl` only checks fenced blocks it judges runnable; a documented statement inside prose or a Syntax template is not checked, so grep the syntax entries for each documented statement keyword when adding or removing a form. ako/mxcli#755.
